count_definition: A declared unit may be two days, an open-ended composition task or one narrative path. It is not a count of full games completed. Partial attempts remain partial despite core gameplay evidence.

titles.title: Sort the Court!
titles.assistance: No walkthrough or input aiming assistance; agent-operated visible controls.
titles.endpoint: Two days, funded-jester payoff and same-context day-three reload; exact pending visitor changed.

titles.title: Six Cats Under
titles.assistance: Initial public-comment hints, then deliberate walkthrough; no source/state injection.
titles.endpoint: Room changes and remote exposed; channel interaction unresolved. Actual unfinished-run reload restarted opening.

titles.title: Adventures With Anxiety
titles.assistance: Screenshot/OCR-based dialogue controls; creator interview read after initial chapter choices; no walkthrough used to choose options.
titles.endpoint: One safe story path, epilogue, credits and resources/Replay panel; actual chapter resume and post-completion reload to Replay/Chapter Select verified. Alternate bad ending and two optional discussion branches unplayed.

titles.title: We Become What We Behold
titles.assistance: Visible-image aiming; prior strategy and later criticism disclosed; two separate runs.
titles.endpoint: First run: hat adoption and attack/fear consequence. Follow-up: mocked couple/embarrassment and title re-entry. Neither reached ending.
titles.remaining: Complete cycle and post-completion re-entry; do not pool runs into one completion.

titles.title: Townscaper
titles.assistance: Desktop-edition review exposed deletion controls before resumed composition.
titles.endpoint: Blue annex and connected pier, correction, revision, voluntary finish, exit/re-entry. Default starter returned; explicit save not tested.

titles.title: A Dance of Fire and Ice
titles.assistance: Screenshot-guided navigation and timed key cadence; audio not heard and calibration unverified.
titles.endpoint: Track 1-1 entered; collapse, explicit Late!!, Space retry and Escape/menu observed. Highest Level Reached 1 is not completion.
titles.remaining: Complete tutorial with audible playback and reliable calibration; observe return separately.
